name: hex-swatch
description: Shows a small color square next to every hex color (#rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa) in Claude's replies.

glyph.title: Swatch
glyph.description: The square drawn before each hex code. The double block is the tallest: it fills the whole line and, two cells wide, is almost square.

codeBlocks.title: Code blocks
codeBlocks.description: squares redraws a code block that holds a color as plain rows with the squares (it loses its syntax highlighting); keep leaves it as it is, without squares.
